findings.title: No single supplied workflow executes Slice 8, Slice 9, and Slice 10 together
findings.rationale: The governing three-loop rule required three construction loops followed by one combined independent review; it did not require an integrated post-batch candidate or combined CI run. The review evaluated the exact sibling candidates individually and found no Critical self-grant path.
findings.required_action: Before any claim of combined Slice 8+9+10 composition/integration, execute an exact combined candidate workflow that includes all three suites and inherited regressions.

findings.title: Later sibling immutability checks do not cover earlier unclosed sibling slice files
findings.rationale: Slices 8, 9, and 10 are sibling loops sharing the closed Slice 7 base, not a descendant chain. Each exact candidate is independently identified and reviewed; no claim is made that Slice 9 or 10 preserves files that are not ancestors in its tree.
findings.required_action: Before composition/integration of the sibling slices, freeze the exact component SHAs or assert byte identity of all three reviewed slice artifacts in the combined candidate.

findings.title: Slice 8 I8-11 revalidation-first wording is stronger than the tested global validation precedence
findings.rationale: The mechanism revalidates EffectIntent before effect-intent/idempotency binding decisions, while record-local shape/state checks occur earlier. This does not create authority or false-green within the bounded local claim.
findings.required_action: Before claiming global failure precedence as 'EffectIntent revalidated first', either narrow the wording to binding-order precedence or add dual-invalid precedence tests and implementation ordering consistent with the claim.

findings.title: Slice 8, 9, and 10 markers omit a self-contained exact_candidate field
findings.rationale: Exact candidate identities are independently bound by the review packet and exact-checkout final workflow logs.
findings.required_action: Add explicit exact_candidate/self_identity fields to future marker schema or closure metadata where practical.

adjudication_basis: combined fresh blind independent review returned BOUNDED_PASS
no Critical or High false-green/self-grant finding was identified
all three exact candidates have preserved mechanism-absent RED evidence and exact-candidate final green runs
the three-loop governing rule required combined independent review after three sibling construction loops and did not require post-review composition
all higher-authority flags remain false and are preserved as nonclaims
reviewer observations are retained as open nonblocking hardening rather than erased
